It seems the new functions are pretty much identical to the existing ones. Instead of duplicating the code, could we call checkAndVerifyImage() once more but setting hashType to the new sha3_512HashFunc value?
The systemLevelVerify() function would just need updating to build the paths from the top level or the MLDSA subdir.
Refactored the code to avoid duplication. Please review

Also if you wouldn't mind replying to your email "Adopting FIPS 204 (ML-DSA) Post-Quantum Encryption Standards in BMC Tar Image" to notify the community that support is coming, it may be useful too to mention that an private community key won't be added because the quantum verification is optional and we already have the default SHA key.
Acknowledged

This function is being called 3 times, we could minimize the amount file open operations if we call it from the constructor were the "keyType/HashType" variables are being initialized, and save the PQAlgorithm result for the other functions to use.

It is interesting that the sha functions can take the upper case value "RSA-SHA256" but for "SHA3-512" it needs to be lower case.
Tested on OpenSSL 3.5.4 - EVP_get_digestbyname() accepts both 'SHA3-512' and 'sha3-512'.
Use 'imageFullSig',it was already defined above.
